rxn_name: Rh catalyzed hydroformylation of linear alpha olefins
procedure: General Procedure for the Hydroformylation of 1-octene. In an N2-filled glovebox, stock solutions of [Rh(acac)CO2] (10x, 6.58 mg, 0.26 mmol) and the bisphosphine ligand (10x, 0.51 mmol) were prepared in toluene (1.0 mL). These solutions were stirred at room temperature until completely homogenous. In a separate Biotage Enedeavor liner tube, 1-octene (200.0 uL, 1.27 mmol) was added to toluene (2 mL), followed by 100 uL of the Rh/L stock solution, resulting in 2 mol% [Rh] and 4 mol% bisphosphine ligand. The tube was placed into the Endeavour instrument under air. The instrument was then purged with N2 (2x), then pressurized to 5 bar with H2 then 5 bar CO and heated to 80 °C for 4 hours. After this time, the reaction was cooled to rt, then analyzed by GC-FID to determine the l:b ratio.

In an N2-filled glovebox, stock solutions of [Rh(acac)CO2] (10x, 6.58 mg, 0.26 mmol) and the bisphosphine ligand (10x, 0.51 mmol) were prepared in toluene (1.0 mL). These solutions were stirred at room temperature until completely homogenous. In a separate Biotage Enedeavor liner tube, 1-octene (200.0 uL, 1.27 mmol) was added to toluene (2 mL), followed by 100 uL of the Rh/L stock solution, resulting in 2 mol% [Rh] and 4 mol% bisphosphine ligand. The tube was placed into the Endeavour instrument under air. The instrument was then purged with N2 (2x), then pressurized to 5 bar with H2 then 5 bar CO and heated to 80 °C for 4 hours. After this time, the reaction was cooled to rt, then analyzed by GC-FID to determine the l:b ratio.
